subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

The area is full of quaint _________ villages.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"little"** means small in size, amount, or degree. (छोटा)

 
 
• **Example: **She has a** little** puppy that is very playful.
 
 
 
• **"Quaint"** refers to something attractively unusual or old-fashioned. (पुराना पर आकर्षक)
 
 
• **Example: **The town is known for its** quaint **cottages and charming streets.
 
 
 
• Hence, the phrase **"quaint little villages" **makes perfect sense as it describes villages that are charmingly small and old-fashioned.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: a little** (थोड़ा): Slight in amount.

 
 
• **Example:** I need a little help with my homework.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: puny** (कमज़ोर): Small and weak.
 
 
• **Example:** He felt puny and insignificant compared to the towering athletes.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: short** (छोटा): Having little length.
 
 
• **Example:** He gave a short speech at the event.
 
 

32:Tbf0,

The correct answer is: Option 4.</
